rule: RULE #1 (Ricardo, 11-20): the harness never gets in the way of the work. Only hard lines may refuse: money, credentials, send-as-ricardo, permanent-delete, egress, third-party-code. Everything else is fail-open: warn, log, continue. `pending` = general decides; old behaviour kept meanwhile. `general-keep` = general decided it keeps refusing.
